Co-op saves live only on the host's computer: guests never write a copy, so a run always has exactly one version. Each player is stored by their Steam or Epic account, so when the host reopens the room, every friend who joins with the same account gets their own character, skills and squad back.
Everything you need for your first run.
Hold the paper arena for 10 minutes. Monster waves keep growing and elite blocks arrive at 2, 5 and 9 minutes. If every player falls, the run is lost.
Every kill adds to one shared team level. When it rises the world pauses and each player picks one of three skill cards: 20 skills in 5 families, each up to rank 5.
Press E near a wandering companion to add it to your tail; it follows you and fires with you. Hold Q to charge and release to throw your first companion at the enemy.
Supply crates fall every 40 seconds. Walk over one to arm yourself and your whole squad with a rifle, shotgun, sniper, machine gun or rocket launcher.
Single player brings three AI teammates who fight, level up and pick skills on their own. Bullets never hurt teammates, but they do shove them along the shot, so mind your line of fire.
Create or join rooms on Steam or Epic (EOS) for up to 10 players. The host can save a co-op run and continue it later with the same friends.
Line defense · draw walls into a maze, then fight on the field yourself.

Profiles stay on this PC and come with you into friends' rooms. The host works out rewards; your own machine writes them.
Right-drag on the paper to draw walls (10 ink a cell); right-drag a wall to erase it. Enemies take the shortest open road to the core.
Throw a square or bigger onto open paper to pin it as a turret. E recruits triangles, F merges the last one forward.

Nothing here can be lost: broken targets stand up again and the triangles are topped up. A polygon thrown at a target bursts into triangles; one that comes to rest on the bullseye scores.
The tutorial can be replayed while you are alone in the hub.
Walk with WASD into the blinking ring.
Aim with the mouse and hold the left button: break both paper targets.
Walk up to a triangle and press E. Recruit two into your tail.
Press F: the last triangle in your tail merges into the one before it and makes a square. Sides are the tier.
Hold Q to charge and release to throw the square onto empty paper: it pins itself as a turret.
A square that hits a target bursts into triangles: recruit them and merge again.
Hold the right button and drag across the blinking cells: three cells of wall make the enemies walk around.
Press Enter for the wave and hold the core: your turret fires with you.
That is every move the game has. The training corner in your hub has targets and a bullseye whenever you want more practice, and friends can invite you into their hubs through Steam.
